rationale.intuition: MIT overall ~4.5%, EA ~5-6%. Strong unhooked domestic CS 普通公校 estimate 4-12% (compare fixture 001). Phillips Andover historical MIT feeder ~7-10% per Andover College Counseling — engine 当前 HS context cap 1.04× 无法 capture 这种 feeder lift. 真实 industry 区间 8-20%. 0.07 下界让 engine 即使 ignore HS context 也能落在带内 (compare 001's lower bound 0.05); 0.22 上界反映 Andover + spike profile 真实 lift. 与 fixture 001 (相同 profile 无 Andover context) 形成 baseline-vs-feeder 对照, 暴露 engine 当前对 prep HS 不敏感.

sources.name: MIT CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: MIT overall admit rate 4.52%; EA rate ~5.7% (slight lift, non-binding REA-equivalent)

sources.name: Phillips Academy Andover College Counseling Report 2024
sources.evidence: MIT historical admit rate 7-10% from Andover (vs national 4.5%); ~5-8 students per Andover class matriculate to MIT annually

sources.name: The Atlantic - 'The Prep School Pipeline' 2023
sources.evidence: Top 10 US boarding schools (Andover, Exeter, Choate, Lawrenceville, Hotchkiss) see 1.5-2.2× T20 admit lift; effect attributed to LOR quality + counselor advocacy network

wontFix.reason: Same root cause as fixture 096: engine highSchoolContextComponent caps multiplier at 1.04×, insufficient to model real prep-school feeder effects (1.5-2× industry estimate). Andover/Exeter/Choate applicants will read low relative to industry intuition.
wontFix.followUp: Same as fixture 096 — feeder-rate data per (school, HS) pair required to widen cap. Track via PR series on highSchoolContextComponent.
